section_summary: This section comprises State Department despatches, SCAP intelligence charts, municipal reports, and demographic studies regarding post-war population statistics and policy for Japan and East Asia between 1945 and 1949. Central documents include Warren S. Thompson's in-depth policy memorandum advocating birth control to alleviate severe demographic pressure on Japan's limited resources, alongside SCAP's preliminary findings from the October 1, 1947 national census. The collection also documents foreign national populations, particularly Koreans, Chinese, and Russians, in Tokyo, throughout Japanese prefectures, and in Mukden, Manchuria.

subfiles.about: Transmittal of Warren S. Thompson's memorandum regarding a population policy for Japan.
subfiles.from: Warren S. Hunsberger, Division of Research for Far East, Department of State
subfiles.summary: Transmits Warren S. Thompson's population memorandum, highlighting statistical data in paragraphs 1-4 and noting ongoing discussions with Irene Taeuber.
subfiles.title: The Japanese Population Problem
subfiles.to: Max W. Bishop, Division of Northeast Asian Affairs, Department of State

subfiles.about: Detailed analysis of Japan's post-war population pressure and the necessity of establishing birth control policies.
subfiles.summary: Analyzes Japan's severe population pressure, demonstrating that agricultural intensification, limited mineral resources, industrial rehabilitation, foreign trade, and emigration cannot adequately absorb annual population growth. Recommends that Japanese leaders and the public be actively educated in birth control and family limitation with American assistance. Argues that failing to curb population growth will lower living standards and risk future expansionist aggression.
subfiles.title: A Population Policy for Japan
subfiles.to: Chief, Natural Resources Section, GHQ, SCAP

subfiles.about: Report on the April 1947 municipal census of Mukden, alien demographics, Soviet passport screening, and refugee control.
subfiles.from: Augustus S. Chase, American Consulate General, Mukden
subfiles.summary: Reports the municipal census results for Mukden showing 1,191,218 total residents and 22,603 aliens, primarily Koreans and Japanese. Analyzes male population predominance, Soviet citizenship canvassing by S. Seregin eliminating local White Russians, massive post-war Japanese repatriation, and police roundups targeting suspected Communist infiltrators.
subfiles.title: Census of Mukden Population: Total Population; Alien Population and Its Composition (with Especial Reference to Russian Population); Political Significance of Census

subfiles.about: Transmittal of SCAP's report on preliminary results of the October 1, 1947 census of Japan.
subfiles.from: Rolland H. Bushner, Acting United States Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Transmits SCAP's report presenting preliminary demographic results and statistical tables from the October 1, 1947 Japanese census.
subfiles.title: Preliminary Results of a Population Census Taken in Japan Proper on October 1, 1947

subfiles.about: Comprehensive preliminary statistical report on Japan's October 1, 1947 national population census.
subfiles.from: Research and Statistics Division, Economic and Scientific Section, GHQ, SCAP
subfiles.summary: Presents preliminary results of the October 1, 1947 census, establishing an adjusted total population of 78.6 million for Japan proper, representing an increase of 4.6 million since April 1946. Attributes population growth to natural increase and the repatriation of approximately two million Japanese nationals. Provides detailed statistical tables covering sex, urban-rural distributions, prefectural totals, and populations of major cities exceeding 100,000 residents.
subfiles.title: Preliminary Results Population Census of Japan Proper - 1 October 1947

subfiles.about: Transmittal of SCAP report analyzing annual changes and growth trends in Japan's population.
subfiles.from: William Seidensticker, Jr., Acting United States Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Transmits a SCAP report on population changes, summarizing long-term growth, rapid post-war natural increase, and net migration.
subfiles.title: Transmittal of Report on Population Changes in Japan
